sources.limits: The source adds physical capital; our model has no capital input, reversible or irreversible. Its numerical/historical evidence, assignment-model sections and full course are not imported. The source discounted welfare discussion states a solution without our complete finite-T verification; that proof is original here. Source extracted equations have sign/index irregularities; we independently derive all value, entry and welfare expressions. No universal non-CRS inefficiency claim or real-world bargaining estimate is adopted.
